messages:
elaine: Hey @eng-runtime — final blog draft needs a quick bench sanity check. Can we get a smoke rerun for 3 hero payloads?

sam: sure — what do you need exactly?

mike: Need coldstart p95/p99, embed batch latency (20 items), and fp16 vs 8bit comparison. Two sanitized example outputs for the blog.

elaine: payloads: short support prompt; long multi-turn ~2k tokens; embed batch. models: rwd-1-xl-fp16, rwd-1-xl-8bit, rwd-2-base-fp16. region: us-west1.

tara: please run both 30s and 5m warmup so we can show warmup sensitivity. capture tokenization time separately for the long convo.

sam: Plan: 200 queries per payload per config for a smoke, capture p50/p95/p99 and traces for p99 outliers. will post artifacts and 1-page summary here.

elaine: timeline: need smoke numbers + two example outputs by EOD Thursday. include one-line caveat: "smoke sample; internal larger runs validate stability."

runtime-bot: queue accepted. sam owns runs; tara will validate artifacts. ETA Thursday 6pm PST (4801234690).
